served_as: Identifier as given to the API on 22 November 2026; reasoning is on by default for this model and cannot be turned off; no sampling setting is sent. The development pilot used a cap of 16,000 output tokens, which no request reached; the cap is raised to 64,000 because Calibration Set B is one long document.
settings: max_tokens 64000; every other setting left at the provider's default
requests: one independent request per document; no conversation state; package defaults for concurrency and retries
